text:
Max Sasson might be the most confusing player on the Canucks, and our numbers can't decide either. He has two tags at once. He's due to cool: six goals on 2.4 expected, shooting 30%. And he's due: Vancouver has scored 10 fewer goals than the chances deserve with him on the ice, the biggest gap of anyone on the team.

What's clear is that he helps. The Canucks are about 10 points of expected goal share better with him on the ice than off it, the best mark on a team that badly needs good news, and NHL Edge has his top speed faster than 95% of the league. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking shows him carrying the puck in on 57% of his entries. Wins added ranks him 91st of 504 because his goals have mattered.

He's undrafted, out of Western Michigan, and earned his job in Abbotsford. He also had his first NHL fight against Anaheim last week. Our range has him at 12 to 22 goals over a full season. Expect fewer of his shots to go in and more of his linemates' to.
headline: Sasson's strange, useful start
